result.summary: The overall layout is coherent, but several elements are clipped or inconsistently styled: the horizontal carousel/chip rows are cut off at the right edge with hard-truncated text, the profile avatar appears empty (only a notification dot), and favorite heart buttons use inconsistent treatments between cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the third card is cut off by the viewport and its title 'Trattoria Piccol' is hard-truncated mid-word with no ellipsis, and its delivery fee text is also clipped.
issues.suggestion: Apply text-overflow ellipsis and a fixed card width so titles truncate cleanly ('Trattoria Piccol…'), and use consistent peek/padding so partially visible cards look intentional.

issues.description: The circular element in the top-right header (presumably the profile/avatar button) is an empty light grey circle containing only a red notification dot — no icon, initials or image is rendered.
issues.suggestion: Render an avatar image or fallback person icon/initials inside the button and give it an accessible label such as 'Account'.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is clipped at the right edge, showing a sliver of the next chip with no visual affordance (fade or arrow) indicating it scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add a gradient fade or scroll indicator at the edge, and align the chip row's horizontal padding with the rest of the content.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: white filled circle with dark outline on the ramen card, dark filled circle with white outline on the pizza card. Cards in the 'Fastest near you' row have no heart at all.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button to one style (e.g. semi-transparent dark scrim with white heart) across all cards and decide consistently whether the smaller cards support favoriting.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card is abruptly cut by the bottom tab bar with no fade or bottom padding, so the card and its missing metadata row look broken rather than scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards are never visually severed at the fold.

issues.description: Badge information is redundant/ambiguous: the ramen card shows a '€0 delivery' badge while the metadata line below repeats '€0 delivery', and the pizza card's '-20%' badge lacks any context about what is discounted.
issues.suggestion: Show the promo badge only when it adds information, and expand the discount badge (e.g. '-20% on all pizzas').

issues.description: The green promo banner contains large overlapping translucent circles that are clipped awkwardly at the right and bottom edges, creating a visible seam near the 'Order now' button.
issues.suggestion: Clip decorative shapes to the banner's rounded bounds and reposition them so they do not crowd the CTA.
